title: Q-TRAJ-neglected-seed-outreach: seed/outreach had 139 lines of change, then nothing for 7 days while the rest of the system moved
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:seed/outreach
**Status:** closed

seed/outreach had 139 lines of change, then nothing for 7 days while the rest of the system moved. Evidence: quiet_days 7; system change in the last 7 days 223568.

Find why it went quiet while the system moved: a loop that no longer fires, an area nothing consumes. Fix the loop or retire the area with a recorded disposition.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:seed/outreach` exits 0.

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T04:41:21Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
